read.thesis: Auto capacity is the binding constraint: ICE+EV output rose to 82k/month by year-end from 66k with 92k next year, while core tractor guidance cut from +5% to flattish for FY27.

utilisation.quote: operating at the full capacity that we've set up

capex.quote: we are effectively doubling capacity from where we stand right now

triggers.label: Capacity 66k → 82k → 92k/month
triggers.quote: capacity being outlined here starting this year at 64.5, ending this year at 82, 92 for next year
triggers.highlight: ending this year at 82, 92 for next year

triggers.label: Auto price hikes 5%, Farm 4%
triggers.quote: We have increased prices in Auto by 5%, in Farm by 4%.

triggers.label: Tractor industry +5% cut to flattish
triggers.quote: It's a full year instead of 5, we're reducing it to flattish.

triggers.label: Dealer stock very low
triggers.quote: Physical stocks of everything at dealers are at very, very low levels.

guidance.quote: It's a full year instead of 5, we're reducing it to flattish.
For SUVs, Mahindra outlook, mid to high teens, we maintain that.
we are increasing it slightly to double digit for the industry
ending this year at 82, 92 for next year. And then as our new plant comes upstream, 132 by F31.
18% is still our target. We may go slightly up, we may go slightly down, but we will stay with 18 as a target.

prior_guidance_check.metric: Auto operating margin Q2 vs Q1
prior_guidance_check.quote: you can see we've improved from 8.9 to 9.8 and consolidated as well from 7.7 to 8.8

red_flags.label: Tractor cut amid global sub stress
red_flags.quote: three of our global subs are seeing a big industry slowdown

red_flags.label: Commodity inflation outsized
red_flags.quote: Steel is up 17% year-over-year, copper is up 42%, rubber is up 40%
